A [[Gender/Legends|female]] '''individual''' was [[Marriage/Legends|married]] to the man [[Rikel (Centerpoint Station)|Rikel]], the head [[Technician/Legends|technician]] of the destructive [[Centerpoint Station]] during the [[Battle of Centerpoint Station (Second Galactic Civil War)|Battle of Centerpoint Station]]. They were married in secret, because neither her family nor his approved of them being together. Early in the [[Second Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]] and the [[Confederation]],<ref name="Fury" /> which took place between [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]] and [[41 ABY]],<ref name="TERC note" /> she was arrested during a security sweep on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the Galactic Alliance, and [[Death/Legends|died]]. Her death drove Rikel to hate all [[Coruscanti/Legends|Coruscanti]], and the Galactic Alliance to which they belonged. He would go as far as to attempt to destroy their planet with Centerpoint [[Space station/Legends|Station]] in revenge, but doing so caused his own death, and the destruction of the station.<ref name="Fury" />

==Behind the scenes==
Rikel's wife was mentioned in the [[2007]] novel ''[[Legacy of the Force: Fury]]'', written by [[Aaron Allston]].<ref name="Fury" />
